datasets: mro_crism_mtrdr (frt000058a3, frt0000b6f1, frt00021c92, frt0000c518, frt0002037a, hrl0000baba, hrl0000d21c, hrl0000d349, hrl0001233b)
terrain/hydration_1024.png.transform: 500 m spatial-block GroupKFold CV: R2=0.364, Spearman=0.582, MAE=0.370 vs baseline 0.486 (n=1567, blocks=36)
terrain/hydration_1024.png.notes: Lateral 1024x1024 WEH map aligned to terrain/meta.json (4000 m HiRISE window). Note that companion hydration_sites.json elev_m values come from pre-geoid CTX DEM (IAU Mars 2015 sphere) and sit ~588-592 m below MOLA-referenced HiRISE DTM elevations.

vertical_datum_offset.datum_explanation: tools/hydration/build_dataset.py sampled the un-geoid-adjusted USGS CTX DEM (-DEM.tif), whose heights are relative to the IAU Mars (2015) Sphere (R=3396190 m) prior to ASP dem_geoid --geoid MOLA adjustment. Both the companion USGS CTX geoid-adjusted product (-DEM-geoid-adj.tif) and the HiRISE SOCET DTM (DTEEC_009149_1750_009294_1750_U01) are referenced to the MOLA areoid, which lies ~562-564 m below the 3396190 m sphere at Gale Crater (-4.745N, 137.400E). The remaining ~25-28 m between HiRISE and CTX -DEM-geoid-adj.tif reflects independent bundle/MOLA-control registration and 1 m vs 20 m posting differences.
